title: Prices, incomes, construction and rents in Portugal's housing market, 2008–2025: a reproducible descriptive assessment

creators.name: Ribeiro, Diogo
creators.affiliation: Faculdade de Media Artes e Design, Universidade Técnica do Porto

description:
Research release v1.0.0: a reproducible descriptive assessment of house prices, incomes, construction, population and rents in Portugal, its 9 NUTS 2 and 26 NUTS 3 regions and 308 municipalities, 2008–2025.

The archive contains the research report (REPORT.md), pinned source files from official statistics with SHA-256 checksums, standard-library Python code, unit and reproduction tests, generated results and 21 figures. Running python reproduce.py verifies the checksums, runs the tests and rebuilds every result byte for byte.

The report separates established descriptive findings, descriptive associations and unresolved causal hypotheses. None of its associations is causal.

Licences: original code and documentation are under the Apache License 2.0. Third-party data are not relicensed: INE data are reused under CC BY 4.0, and Eurostat and ECB data under their providers' reuse terms, with the attributions listed file by file in DATA_SOURCES.csv and DATA_SOURCES.md.
notes: Build the archive with the release-archive task of .github/workflows/portugal-housing-generations.yml from the tag portugal-housing-generations-v1.0.0; it stops while DATA_SOURCES.md lists any file whose redistribution has not been established. Publish the archive's SHA-256 from the workflow artifact with the deposit.
